big_case.notes: A genuine, acknowledged circuit split on the FMLA retaliation causation standard (motivating factor under 29 C.F.R. 825.220(c) vs. but-for), sharpened by Loper Bright, on a high-volume federal employment claim; two employer-side amici filed at the cert stage. But it arose from an unpublished Second Circuit summary order resting on invited-error/forfeiture grounds, between a mid-sized employer and one former employee, and the Court denied it at its first conference without calling for a response.
